title.rendered: The 19th edition of Sunburn Festival moves to Mahalaxmi Racecourse with a reimagined two-day format.

content.rendered:
Every December, as the year edges towards its final countdown, a familiar surge begins to build – one that doesn’t belong to a single city, but to an entire community. It lives in anticipation, in memories that resurface and in plans that feel almost ritualistic. Over nearly two decades, Sunburn Festival has transformed from a pioneering music event into a cultural phenomenon – one that defines how India celebrates music, scale and togetherness.

This edition, Sunburn Festival 2026 will take place on December 18th and 19th, 2026, with the festival moving to the heart of the entertainment capital, Mahalaxmi Racecourse, one of Mumbai’s most iconic and centrally located live event venues. Known for hosting some of Sunburn’s landmark live moments in the city over the years, from Avicii’s early India performance in 2011 and the iconic Swedish House Mafia’s in 2013 to Martin Garrix’s indelible show in 2016 and Keinemusik’s recent spectacle this year, the venue brings with it both scale and accessibility, enabling a more seamless experience for fans travelling from across the city and beyond. Its central connectivity and familiarity as a large-format event space position it as a natural evolution for a festival of Sunburn’s stature. 

Alongside the venue, Sunburn Festival 2026 will introduce a reimagined format. This edition will be distilled into a more concentrated, high-energy two-day experience, designed to deliver sharper programming and a more immersive flow of power-packed performances. The celebration will culminate in a massive closing party at NSCI Dome on December 20th, extending the experience into a high-impact finale after the headliner’s crescendo at the Racecourse. Together, these changes reflect a deliberate shift towards enhanced immersion and connectivity, placing fan experience at the centre of every decision.

title.rendered: Sunburn Holi Weekend 2026 to bring Holi hues and high energy beats with KSHMR’s 5-city tour

content.rendered:
National, February 6th, 2026: Sunburn Holi Weekend has long been synonymous with music, colour and celebration for EDM fans across India. This festive season, EDM prodigy KSHMR takes centre stage, produced and promoted by Sunburn, Asia’s Premier Electronic Dance Music (EDM) platform, splashing his signature sound across a five-city tour.

Sunburn Holi Weekend 2026 ft. KSHMR will kick off in Mumbai on March 3rd, 2026, featuring a special performance by DJ Chetas, followed by Chennai on March 4th, 2026, Bengaluru on March 6th, 2026, Bhubaneswar on March 7th, 2026 and Hyderabad on March 8th, 2026. The tour marks a significant milestone with KSHMR making his debut performance in Bhubaneswar, bringing his globally acclaimed experience to the city for the very first time. Tickets are available exclusively on BookMyShow, India’s leading entertainment destination.

Niles Hollowell-Dhar, better known as KSHMR, rose from producing hip-hop and pop hits, including anthems ‘Like A G6’, to becoming one of dance music’s most celebrated figures with chart-topping tracks including ‘Secrets’ with Tiësto and ‘Kids’ featuring MKLA. His hits also include ‘Bad’, ‘My Best Life’ and ‘Power’. With 10 Beatport #1s, DJ Mag’s Best Live Act award, his own Dharma Worldwide label and the influential Sounds of KSHMR packs, KSHMR continues to shape global music and headline the world’s biggest stages.
